name: Wesley Stuurman
headline: Product at Google
summary:
Product at Google in Zurich, Switzerland working on the Google Shopping experience and Merchant Interfaces, leveraging the power of AI to improve the user experience. Previously launched Search Generative Experience (SGE) On Content, iOS App Widgets, Circle to Search and Augmented Reality features. Had the privilege to work at Grab in Singapore on Subscriptions & a prepaid MasterCard for South-East-Asia’s unbanked. Also launched the Lazada Wallet and LiveUp loyalty program for Alibaba. 

Graduate from Quantic (Executive MBA), CDTM (Technology Management), TUM (Consumer Affairs) and UCU (Politics & Sociology).

Love technology, travel, exploring and living abroad.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager

positions.description: Product Manager for the Google app on iOS & Android. Led a cross functional product development team of 35 professionals working, among others, on Augmented Reality inclusion & iOS 14 Widgets. Promoted in spring 2021 and fall 2022.

positions.title: Lead Product Manager
positions.description:
“Grab is more than just the leading ride-hailing and mobile payments app in Southeast Asia. We use data and technology to improve everything from transportation to payments and logistics across a region of more than 620 million people. Currently we offer services in Singapore, Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam; however, we also have R&D offices in Bangalore, Beijing, & Seattle.”

Worked on GrabRewards and GrabPay. Launched Grab Subscriptions across the region and Grab’s Mastercard integration, enabling global payments with Grabpay balance.

positions.title: Senior Manager, Product Development
positions.description:
Lazada is Southeast Asia’s fastest growing online department store, with operations in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Vietnam. 

Co-leading a team of 20 product development professionals, with direct reports, in bringing the checkout, payments and loyalty (LiveUp program) experience for our users to the next level. This includes adding new payment methods, checkout redesigns, conversion optimization and working with risk, legal, compliance and finance on the right product implementation. Moreover, I manage the quarterly roadmap with our business sponsors including new features, technical debt and further product enhancements. 

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer of the Lazada Group with end to end responsibility for the alignment, implementation (including technical design) and continued excellence of Lazada's checkout, payments  and loyalty product operations.

positions.title: Payments Product Manager
positions.description:
Lazada is Southeast Asia’s fastest growing online department store, with operations in Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Vietnam. 

Lazada is pioneering eCommerce across some of the fastest growing countries in the world by offering a fast, secure and convenient online shopping experience with a broad product offering in categories ranging from consumer electronics to household goods, toys and the latest fashion brands.

I am responsible for the product management of checkout and payments across all six ventures. This includes executing upon the quarterly roadmap, managing a portfolio of over 40+ payment method integrations and quarterbacking feature requests across 10+ teams.

Promoted to Product Development Lead with a direct reporting line to the Chief Product officer after 7 months.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description:
Experteer is the executive career service for leading professionals. In over 10 countries, Experteer connects professionals to senior-level jobs across Europe. More than 5 million professionals use Experteer. 

I am currently responsible for the B2C product portfolio. For my projects, I conceptualise solutions and present it to the management team and business owners. I also take care of the end-to-end execution and roll-outs of each project which include user-story writing and prototype-building. In cooperation with dedicated designers and developers we have launched multiple projects including page redesigns and the introduction of social features onsite.
